design.title: Seekra — Product Profile
design.reference: Apple.com-class scrolling experience — cinematic spacing, one big idea per slide, alternating dark/light chapters, soft radial tan glows on dark surfaces, generous whitespace, no grid patterns. Dark brown #3D2B1D removed per client direction; slide 8 background switched to charcoal. Eyebrows on light slides use #1F1A14 (ink-strong) for high visibility; eyebrows on dark slides remain tan.
design.name_meaning: Seekra = Seek + era — a new era of seeking. Shown on cover slide.
design.client_focus: Gulf region only — Urdu and Pakistani references removed throughout.

slides.title: Cover
slides.task_brief:
DARK COVER SLIDE — slide-dark background (charcoal #202020) with soft radial tan glow in top-left.

LOGO LOCKUP (top-left, vertically centered with wordmark): use the local logo image at relative path 'seekra-icon-512.png' at 44x44px with 10px corner radius, sitting next to the wordmark 'Seekra' rendered in Inter 600 weight at 22px in cream (#E7E6E4).

EYEBROW (top-right, small caps, tan #B59876, 12px, letter-spacing 0.22em): 'SEEKRA · CONTENT-AWARE INTELLIGENCE'

HERO HEADLINE (vertically centered, left-aligned, Inter 700, font-size 92px, line-height 1.05, letter-spacing -0.025em, color cream #E7E6E4):
  'Your documents finally answer back'
  Render the words 'answer back' in tan (#B59876). Render the trailing period in brick red (#B93C32). Make the period slightly larger than the rest.

HERO SUBLINE (just below headline, max-width 720px, Inter 400, 19px, line-height 1.55, color cream at 75% opacity):
  'Seekra is content-aware intelligence that runs entirely on your infrastructure. Ask, see, and speak to your archive — every answer cited to its source.'

FLOATING GLASS CHIPS (positioned around the hero area, frosted-glass feel: background rgba(231,230,228,0.06), border 1px solid rgba(231,230,228,0.16), 6px 14px padding, 999px radius, 13px Inter 500). Four chips:
  • 'Cited answers' (with a tiny Material Icon 'verified' before text, tan)
  • 'العربية · اردو · English' (Arabic text using Noto Naskh Arabic via font-family fallback var(--font-ar))
  • '100% visual match' (with Material Icon 'image_search' before text, tan)
  • 'Air-gapped ready' (with Material Icon 'shield' before text, tan)

CTA ROW (below subline, horizontal row with 24px gap):
  • Primary: tan pill button 'Book a Demo' (background #B59876, text #202020, Inter 600 14px, 14px 26px padding, 999px radius, with right arrow Material Icon 'arrow_forward')
  • Secondary: ghost button 'See how it works' (transparent, border 1px solid rgba(231,230,228,0.30), text cream, Inter 500 14px, 14px 26px padding, 999px radius)

FOOTER BAR (bottom of slide, 12px Inter 500, cream at 50% opacity, letter-spacing 0.10em, uppercase): 'PRODUCT PROFILE · PREPARED FOR ENTERPRISE & GOVERNMENT CLIENTS · 2026'

NO other photos. Background must be solid charcoal — no grid patterns, no dot textures. Use only the local Seekra logo image (relative path 'seekra-icon-512.png').

Speaker notes: short hints — generate 3-5 bullet talking points for opening the client meeting: introduce Seekra in one line, set expectations for what the deck will cover, anchor on the headline 'Your documents finally answer back', mention the four capability pillars (Ask / See / Speak / Trust), and transition to the executive summary.

slides.title: Executive Summary
slides.task_brief:
LIGHT SLIDE — slide-light background (cream #E7E6E4), text color dark brown/ink (#1F1A14).

LEFT COLUMN (60% width, padding-right 48px):
  EYEBROW (12px Inter 600, letter-spacing 0.22em, uppercase, tan #B59876): 'EXECUTIVE SUMMARY'
  HEADLINE (Inter 700, 48px, line-height 1.15, letter-spacing -0.02em, color #3D2B1D, max-width 600px, top margin 16px):
    'One platform. Your entire archive. Nothing leaves the building.'
    Render the word 'Nothing' in tan (#B59876) for emphasis.
  PARAGRAPH 1 (Inter 400, 17px, line-height 1.65, color #4A3F33, top margin 28px, max-width 580px):
    'Seekra is a content-aware intelligence platform that runs entirely on the customer\u2019s own infrastructure. Organizations upload their documents — contracts, policies, case files, scanned images, field photographs — and Seekra lets their staff ask questions in natural language, search by image, and speak to the archive in Arabic, Urdu, or English.'
  PARAGRAPH 2 (same style, top margin 16px):
    'Every answer carries numbered citations that link directly to the exact source page. Personal information is automatically masked before any AI model is involved. Role-based access controls and a complete audit trail make Seekra suitable for the most regulated Gulf and Pakistani environments — including fully air-gapped deployments where no external network connection is permitted.'

RIGHT COLUMN (40% width, vertically centered): a 2x2 grid of capability cards, each card 240x140px, white background #FFFFFF, 1px border rgba(61,43,29,0.12), 14px radius, 24px padding. Each card shows:
  • A Material Icon (tan #B59876, 32px) at top-left
  • A capability label (Inter 600, 13px, letter-spacing 0.18em, uppercase, color #3D2B1D)
  • A one-line description (Inter 400, 13px, color #4A3F33, line-height 1.45)
  Card 1 — icon 'forum', label 'ASK', desc 'Conversational Q&A with citations'
  Card 2 — icon 'image_search', label 'SEE', desc 'Search the archive with a photograph'
  Card 3 — icon 'mic', label 'SPEAK', desc 'Arabic-first voice interaction'
  Card 4 — icon 'shield', label 'TRUST', desc 'Self-hosted. Nothing leaves the box.'

NO header or footer bar. Solid cream background only. No photos.

Speaker notes: short hints — 3-5 bullet talking points summarizing: (1) what Seekra is in one sentence, (2) the three input modes — text, image, voice, (3) every answer is verifiable through page-level citations, (4) PII is masked before any AI sees it, (5) deployment options include air-gapped for the most regulated environments.

slides.title: The Problem
slides.task_brief:
LIGHT SLIDE — slide-light background (cream #E7E6E4).

TOP BLOCK (padding-bottom 36px):
  EYEBROW (tan #B59876, 12px Inter 600, uppercase, letter-spacing 0.22em): 'WHY SEEKRA EXISTS'
  HEADLINE (Inter 700, 44px, line-height 1.15, letter-spacing -0.02em, color #3D2B1D, top margin 14px):
    'Three problems every large archive suffers from.'
    Render the period in brick red (#B93C32).

THREE-CARD GRID (3 columns, 24px gap, each card 360x340px, white #FFFFFF background, 1px border rgba(61,43,29,0.10), 14px radius, 32px padding). Each card vertically structured:
  • A large numeral at top (Inter 600, 28px, color tan #B59876, font-feature-settings 'tnum'): '01' / '02' / '03'
  • A Material Icon below the numeral (tan #B59876, 36px)
  • Card headline (Inter 600, 22px, line-height 1.25, color #3D2B1D, top margin 16px)
  • Card body (Inter 400, 15px, line-height 1.6, color #4A3F33, top margin 12px)

CARD 01: icon 'folder_off', headline 'Knowledge buried in files', body 'Critical information lives inside thousands of PDFs, scans, and Office documents that no one can effectively search. Staff spend hours locating a single clause, and institutional knowledge walks out the door when experienced employees leave.'

CARD 02: icon 'cloud_off', headline 'Cloud AI means data leaves the building', body 'Mainstream AI assistants ask you to upload your documents to their servers. For government, legal, healthcare, and financial work, that is often non-negotiable — the data cannot leave your jurisdiction or your network.'

CARD 03: icon 'help_outline', headline 'Answers without sources can\u2019t be trusted', body 'When an AI produces an answer with no link to where the information came from, it cannot be verified. In regulated environments, an unverifiable answer is the same as no answer at all.'

NO photos. Solid cream background.

Speaker notes: short hints — 3-5 bullet talking points: (1) anchor on the three pain points, (2) emphasize these are universal across regulated sectors, (3) transition with 'Seekra was built to solve all three at once' — sets up the next slide on the Seekra approach.

slides.title: The Seekra Approach
slides.task_brief:
DARK SLIDE — slide-dark background (charcoal #202020) with one soft radial tan glow positioned top-right (.glow-tan.tr).

TOP BLOCK (max-width 900px):
  EYEBROW (tan #B59876, 12px Inter 600, uppercase, letter-spacing 0.22em): 'THE SEEKRA APPROACH'
  HEADLINE (Inter 700, 52px, line-height 1.10, letter-spacing -0.025em, color cream #E7E6E4, top margin 14px):
    'Bring the intelligence to your documents — not the other way around.'
    Render the word 'intelligence' in tan (#B59876) for emphasis.
  LEAD PARAGRAPH (Inter 400, 17px, line-height 1.6, color cream at 72% opacity, top margin 24px, max-width 880px):
    'Cloud AI assistants are excellent generalists, but they ask you to hand them your documents. Seekra reverses the relationship: the platform runs entirely on your infrastructure, masks personal data before any model sees it, and proves every answer with a citation you can open.'

2x2 GRID (4 pillar cards, top margin 36px, 24px gap, each card 540x190px, background rgba(231,230,228,0.04), 1px border rgba(231,230,228,0.10), 14px radius, 24px padding). Each card horizontal layout: left side a 64x64 tan-tinted square (background rgba(181,152,118,0.12), 12px radius) holding a Material Icon (tan #B59876, 32px); right side text content:
  • Pillar label (Inter 600, 13px, letter-spacing 0.18em, uppercase, color tan #B59876)
  • Headline (Inter 600, 19px, color cream #E7E6E4, top margin 4px)
  • Body (Inter 400, 14px, line-height 1.55, color cream at 68% opacity, top margin 6px)

PILLAR 1: icon 'forum', label 'ASK', headline 'Conversational Q&A', body 'Chat with the entire archive in natural language. Every answer carries numbered citations that deep-link to the exact source page.'

PILLAR 2: icon 'image_search', label 'SEE', headline 'Search by image', body 'Upload a photo or scan; Seekra finds visually similar items across the archive with similarity scores and detected-content labels.'

PILLAR 3: icon 'mic', label 'SPEAK', headline 'Arabic-first voice', body 'Full voice interaction with Arabic as a first-class citizen, alongside Urdu and English. Built for the Gulf and Pakistan.'

PILLAR 4: icon 'shield', label 'TRUST', headline 'Nothing leaves the box', body 'Self-hosted on your servers, including fully air-gapped. PII masked before any AI. Role-based access and full audit logging.'

NO photos.

Speaker notes: short hints — 3-5 bullet talking points: (1) state the positioning line clearly, (2) walk through the four pillars quickly — each gets a deeper slide next, (3) emphasize this is one integrated platform, not four separate products, (4) highlight that 'Trust' is built in, not bolted on.

slides.title: Capability 01 — Ask
slides.task_brief:
LIGHT SLIDE — slide-light background (cream #E7E6E4). Split layout: LEFT 52% text, RIGHT 48% browser-frame mockup.

LEFT COLUMN:
  EYEBROW (tan #B59876, 12px Inter 600, uppercase, letter-spacing 0.22em): 'CAPABILITY 01 · ASK'
  HEADLINE (Inter 700, 46px, line-height 1.12, letter-spacing -0.025em, color #3D2B1D, top margin 14px, max-width 540px):
    'Answers you can verify in one click.'
    Render the period in brick red (#B93C32).
  BODY PARAGRAPH (Inter 400, 16px, line-height 1.65, color #4A3F33, top margin 22px, max-width 520px):
    'Staff type a question in plain language and Seekra responds with an answer drawn from the organization\u2019s own documents. Every claim in the response is marked with a numbered citation that links to the exact source document and page, opening instantly in the built-in viewer.'
  BENEFIT LIST (top margin 22px, 4 items, vertical stack with 14px gap). Each item: a row with a small tan check icon (Material Icon 'check_circle' in tan #B59876 at 18px) and the benefit text (Inter 500, 14px, color #3D2B1D, line-height 1.5):
    • 'Natural-language questions — no query syntax to learn'
    • 'Numbered citations link to the exact source page'
    • 'Built-in viewer opens PDF, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint in the browser'
    • 'Critical for compliance-driven buyers who require verifiable AI'

RIGHT COLUMN — BROWSER FRAME MOCKUP (centered vertically, 480x420px, white background #FFFFFF, 1px border rgba(61,43,29,0.18), 12px radius, soft tan-tinted shadow 0 12px 40px rgba(181,152,118,0.18)). Inside:
  • Browser chrome bar at top (height 36px, background #F5F4F2, bottom border 1px solid rgba(61,43,29,0.08), padding 0 16px). Three dots (left, 8px circles: #B93C32, #B59876, #3D2B1D) and a URL pill (centered, background #FFFFFF, 1px border rgba(61,43,29,0.10), 4px radius, padding 4px 14px, 11px Inter 500 monospace color #4A3F33): 'app.seekra.pk'
  • Content area (padding 24px). A mock chat:
    – USER BUBBLE (right-aligned, max-width 80%, background #3D2B1D, color cream, 12px padding, 10px radius, 13px Inter 400): 'What does our policy say about data retention for customer records?'
    – ANSWER BLOCK (left-aligned, top margin 16px, max-width 92%): a small label 'SEEKRA' (10px Inter 600, letter-spacing 0.18em, uppercase, tan #B59876), then the answer text (Inter 400, 13px, line-height 1.55, color #1F1A14): 'Customer records must be retained for seven years from the date of account closure, after which they are securely destroyed [1]. Records flagged as part of an active investigation are exempt and held until legal release [2].'
    – CITATION CHIPS (top margin 12px, horizontal row, 8px gap): two chips, each is a small pill (background rgba(181,152,118,0.14), border 1px solid rgba(181,152,118,0.32), 4px 10px padding, 999px radius, 11px Inter 500 color #3D2B1D): '[1] Customer Data Policy v3 · p.14' and '[2] Legal Hold Procedure · p.3'

NO photos. Background solid cream.

Speaker notes: short hints — 3-5 bullet talking points: (1) emphasize 'verify in one click' as the key buying argument, (2) demonstrate the citation chip → source page flow conceptually, (3) mention that PDF/Word/Excel/PowerPoint all open in the browser — no Office install, (4) tie to compliance: regulators want audit trails of how a decision was reached.

slides.title: Capability 02 — See
slides.task_brief:
LIGHT SLIDE — slide-light background (cream #E7E6E4). Split layout: LEFT 48% browser-frame mockup, RIGHT 52% text. (Mirror of slide 05 — visual alternation.)

LEFT COLUMN — BROWSER FRAME MOCKUP (centered vertically, 480x420px, white #FFFFFF background, 1px border rgba(61,43,29,0.18), 12px radius, soft tan-tinted shadow 0 12px 40px rgba(181,152,118,0.18)).
  • Browser chrome bar (same as slide 05: dots + URL pill 'app.seekra.pk')
  • Content area (padding 20px):
    – Section label (10px Inter 600, letter-spacing 0.18em, uppercase, color #4A3F33): 'VISUAL SEARCH'
    – Upload tile (top margin 8px, 100% width, height 110px, dashed 2px border rgba(181,152,118,0.45), 10px radius, centered content: Material Icon 'cloud_upload' tan #B59876 32px, then 12px Inter 500 color #4A3F33: 'Upload a photo or scan')
    – Results label (top margin 18px, 10px Inter 600 letter-spacing 0.18em uppercase color #4A3F33): 'SIMILAR RESULTS'
    – Results grid (top margin 8px, 3 columns, 8px gap). Each result tile 130x95px, background #F5F4F2, 1px border rgba(61,43,29,0.10), 8px radius. Inside each tile: a tan-tinted placeholder rectangle (top, 130x55px, background linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(181,152,118,0.30), rgba(181,152,118,0.10)), with a centered Material Icon 'image' tan #B59876 24px). Below: a similarity bar (4px tall, background rgba(61,43,29,0.08), with a tan fill at 92% / 86% / 78%) and a tiny label (10px Inter 500 color #4A3F33): '92% match', '86% match', '78% match'.
    – Detected-content caption (top margin 12px, 11px Inter 400 italic color #4A3F33): 'Detected: site inspection · equipment · safety helmet'

RIGHT COLUMN (padding-left 40px):
  EYEBROW (tan #B59876, 12px Inter 600, uppercase, letter-spacing 0.22em): 'CAPABILITY 02 · SEE'
  HEADLINE (Inter 700, 46px, line-height 1.12, letter-spacing -0.025em, color #3D2B1D, top margin 14px, max-width 540px):
    'Search your archive with a photograph.'
    Render the period in brick red (#B93C32).
  BODY PARAGRAPH (Inter 400, 16px, line-height 1.65, color #4A3F33, top margin 22px, max-width 520px):
    'Upload a photo, scanned image, or screenshot, and Seekra finds visually similar items across the entire archive using image similarity. Each result shows a similarity score and a label describing what the image most likely shows, plus the documents it relates to.'
  BENEFIT LIST (top margin 22px, 4 items, vertical stack with 14px gap, same format as slide 05 with tan 'check_circle' icon at 18px and Inter 500 14px text in #3D2B1D):
    • 'Field inspections, damage photos, site images — searchable without any text'
    • 'Image-to-image similarity with detected-content labels'
    • 'A differentiator almost no competitor offers'
    • 'Works for scans, photographs, screenshots, and document page images'

NO photos.

Speaker notes: short hints — 3-5 bullet talking points: (1) this is a true differentiator — almost no competitor offers image-based archive search, (2) ideal for field operations: damage photos, site inspections, equipment photos, (3) results are scored so the user sees confidence, (4) detected-content labels make the search explainable.

slides.title: Capability 03 — Speak
slides.task_brief:
DARK SLIDE — slide-dark background (charcoal #202020) with two soft radial tan glows: one top-left (.glow-tan.tl) and one bottom-right (.glow-tan.br).

LAYOUT: vertically centered single column, max-width 980px, left-aligned with horizontal padding.

EYEBROW (tan #B59876, 12px Inter 600, uppercase, letter-spacing 0.22em): 'CAPABILITY 03 · SPEAK'

HEADLINE (Inter 700, 60px, line-height 1.10, letter-spacing -0.025em, color cream #E7E6E4, top margin 16px):
  'Speak to your archive. In Arabic, Urdu, or English.'
  Render the period in brick red (#B93C32).

ARABIC ACCENT CHIP (top margin 28px, large pill: background rgba(181,152,118,0.14), border 1px solid rgba(181,152,118,0.36), 12px 22px padding, 999px radius, 20px font). Inside: 'العربية · اردو · English' — the Arabic word 'العربية' rendered with font-family: var(--font-ar) for proper shaping. Color cream #E7E6E4 with the three language names separated by middle dots in tan #B59876.

BODY PARAGRAPH (Inter 400, 18px, line-height 1.6, color cream at 78% opacity, top margin 28px, max-width 820px):
  'Seekra supports full voice interaction — speech in, spoken answers out. Arabic is a first-class citizen, with correct right-to-left rendering and Arabic-capable fonts. Urdu and English sit alongside it with full parity, not as a translated afterthought.'

BENEFIT LIST (top margin 28px, 4 items in a 2-column grid, 24px column gap, 14px row gap). Each item: a row with a Material Icon (tan #B59876, 22px) and Inter 500 15px cream text:
  • icon 'mic', text 'Speech-to-text in, spoken answers out'
  • icon 'translate', text 'Arabic as a first-class citizen — proper RTL rendering'
  • icon 'language', text 'Urdu and English with full parity'
  • icon 'public', text 'Built for the Gulf and Pakistani markets where this combination is rare'

NO photos. Solid charcoal background with the two soft radial glows.

Speaker notes: short hints — 3-5 bullet talking points: (1) full voice loop — input and output, not just transcription, (2) Arabic is genuinely first-class: RTL, font shaping, Naskh fallback, (3) Urdu and English are equals, not translations, (4) emphasize rarity in the Gulf market — most competing tools have shallow Arabic support.

slides.title: Trust — Security & Sovereignty
slides.task_brief:
DARK SLIDE — slide-brown background (dark brown #3D2B1D) with one soft radial tan glow positioned top-right (.glow-tan.tr). This is the EMOTIONAL CLIMAX of the deck for Gulf buyers — give it weight and presence.

TOP BLOCK (max-width 900px):
  EYEBROW (tan #B59876, 12px Inter 600, uppercase, letter-spacing 0.22em): 'TRUST · SECURITY & SOVEREIGNTY'
  HEADLINE (Inter 700, 64px, line-height 1.05, letter-spacing -0.03em, color cream #E7E6E4, top margin 14px):
    'Nothing leaves the box'
    Render the period in brick red (#B93C32). Make the period visually prominent (slightly larger).
  LEAD PARAGRAPH (Inter 400, 17px, line-height 1.6, color cream at 78% opacity, top margin 22px, max-width 860px):
    'This is the decisive argument for government, legal, healthcare, and financial buyers. Seekra runs entirely on the customer\u2019s own infrastructure — cloud VM, on-premises, or fully air-gapped with no external network connection. Personal information is automatically detected and masked before any AI model is involved.'

2x2 GRID (top margin 32px, 24px gap, each card 540x150px, background rgba(231,230,228,0.05), 1px border rgba(231,230,228,0.14), 14px radius, 24px padding). Each card horizontal layout: left side a 56x56 tan-tinted square (background rgba(181,152,118,0.16), 12px radius) holding a Material Icon (tan #B59876, 28px); right side text content:
  • Card title (Inter 600, 18px, color cream #E7E6E4)
  • Card body (Inter 400, 14px, line-height 1.55, color cream at 70% opacity, top margin 6px)

CARD 1: icon 'dns', title 'Self-hosted & air-gap ready', body 'Runs on your cloud VM, your on-prem servers, or fully air-gapped. Nothing leaves your infrastructure.'

CARD 2: icon 'visibility_off', title 'PII masked before the AI', body 'Names, ID numbers, emails, and phone numbers are automatically redacted before any text reaches the AI model.'

CARD 3: icon 'admin_panel_settings', title 'Role-based access control', body 'Granular permissions: administrators, editors, viewers, and read-only auditors. Collections can be restricted to specific users.'

CARD 4: icon 'fact_check', title 'Full audit logging', body 'Every security-relevant action is logged with actor and detail — logins, password resets, file events, permission grants. Forensically reconstructable.'

NO photos.

Speaker notes: short hints — 4-5 bullet talking points: (1) pause on the headline — let it land, (2) lead with air-gapped: this is the killer argument for Gulf government, (3) PII masking happens BEFORE the AI sees text — emphasize this is structural, not a setting, (4) RBAC includes a read-only auditor role for oversight teams, (5) audit trail is complete enough for forensic reconstruction of any incident.

slides.title: Capability Comparison
slides.task_brief: LIGHT SLIDE — slide-light background (cream #E7E6E4). TOP BLOCK (padding-bottom 28px): EYEBROW (tan #B59876, 12px Inter 600, uppercase, letter-spacing 0.22em): 'HOW SEEKRA COMPARES' HEADLINE (Inter 700, 42px, line-height 1.15, letter-spacing -0.02em, color #3D2B1D, top margin 14px): 'An honest comparison.' Render the period in brick red (#B93C32). LEAD LINE (Inter 400, 16px, line-height 1.55, color #4A3F33, top margin 14px, max-width 880px): 'Cloud AI assistants are strong for general-purpose work. The comparison below concerns enterprise data handling — where Seekra is purpose-built.' COMPARISON TABLE (full width, top margin 24px, white #FFFFFF background, 1px border rgba(61,43,29,0.12), 12px radius, overflow hidden). Use class 'compare'. Columns: Feature (40%) | Seekra (30%) | Typical Cloud AI Assistant (30%) Header row (background #F5F4F2, 14px Inter 600, color #3D2B1D, letter-spacing 0.14em uppercase, 12px 18px padding): 'CAPABILITY' | 'SEEKRA' | 'TYPICAL CLOUD AI' Body rows (14px Inter 400, color #1F1A14, 14px 18px padding, alternating row backgrounds: even rows transparent, odd rows rgba(61,43,29,0.025)): Row 1: 'Data residency inside your infrastructure' | '✓ Yes' | '✗ No' Row 2: 'Air-gapped / offline option' | '✓ Yes' | '✗ No' Row 3: 'PII masked before AI' | '✓ Yes' | 'Partial' Row 4: 'Page-level citations to source' | '✓ Yes' | 'Partial' Row 5: 'Visual / image search' | '✓ Yes' | 'Partial' Row 6: 'Arabic & Urdu voice (first-class)' | '✓ Yes' | 'Partial' Row 7: 'Offline operation' | '✓ Yes' | '✗ No' Use class 'col-feature' on first column cells for slightly heavier weight (Inter 500). FOOTNOTE (top margin 20px, 12px Inter 400 italic, color #4A3F33, max-width 1000px): 'Cloud AI tools are excellent generalists. This comparison concerns enterprise data handling, sovereignty, and verifiable answers — not general-purpose assistant quality.' NO photos. Speaker notes: short hints — 4-5 bullet talking points: (1) walk the table top-to-bottom, not all rows — pick the three that matter most to the client, (2) emphasize 'Partial' is honest, not a competitor hit — cloud tools are good, just not for this use case, (3) the footnote is mandatory: it positions Seekra as purpose-built, not anti-cloud, (4) close with 'this is why Seekra exists'.

slides.title: Deployment Options
slides.task_brief:
GRAY SLIDE — slide-gray background (warm gray #D8D6D3).

TOP BLOCK (padding-bottom 28px):
  EYEBROW (tan #B59876, 12px Inter 600, uppercase, letter-spacing 0.22em): 'DEPLOYMENT'
  HEADLINE (Inter 700, 44px, line-height 1.15, letter-spacing -0.02em, color #3D2B1D, top margin 14px):
    'Three ways to run Seekra. You choose.'
    Render the period in brick red (#B93C32).
  LEAD PARAGRAPH (Inter 400, 16px, line-height 1.6, color #4A3F33, top margin 16px, max-width 880px):
    'Seekra adapts to your infrastructure policy. Move between deployment models as your needs evolve — the platform stays the same.'

THREE-CARD GRID (3 columns, 24px gap, top margin 32px). The middle card (Air-gapped) is FEATURED — darker, taller, more prominent. Card dimensions: side cards 360x320px white #FFFFFF; middle card 360x340px charcoal #202020 (elevated by 10px via margin-top: -10px).

SIDE CARDS (Cloud VM, On-premises) — 1px border rgba(61,43,29,0.10), 14px radius, 32px padding. Layout:
  • Top: a Material Icon (tan #B59876, 36px) in a 64x64 tan-tinted square (background rgba(181,152,118,0.10), 12px radius)
  • Card title (Inter 600, 22px, color #3D2B1D, top margin 18px)
  • Card body (Inter 400, 14px, line-height 1.6, color #4A3F33, top margin 12px)
  • Bottom small label (top margin 18px, 11px Inter 600 letter-spacing 0.18em uppercase color #B59876): 'STANDARD'

MIDDLE CARD (Air-gapped / offline) — charcoal #202020 background, 1px border rgba(181,152,118,0.30), 14px radius, 32px padding, soft tan glow behind it (a 320x320 radial gradient at 30% opacity). Layout:
  • Top: a Material Icon (tan #B59876, 36px) in a 64x64 tan-tinted square (background rgba(181,152,118,0.18), 12px radius)
  • Card title (Inter 600, 22px, color cream #E7E6E4, top margin 18px): 'Air-gapped / offline'
